items.title: Anthropic may take longer than SpaceX to join major stock indices
items.description: The AI startup could join Russell 1000 on December 11 and the Nasdaq 100 on December 21 if its planned Thursday listing goes ahead, potentially triggering significant demand from index-tracking funds

items.title: Meganet, Rediff.com file IPO papers; Advanced Sys-Tek gets Sebi nod
items.description: Internet firm Rediff.com India has filed updated draft papers with the markets regulator to raise up to ₹600 crore through its initial public offering

items.title: Tata Sons must list, RBI reiterates: What happens next?
items.description: Tata Sons has missed its mandatory stock market listing deadline, and the RBI has issued a fresh reminder ahead of its November 26 board meeting.
